Name: (CP) Iridium Cat and Dog
Description:
I tried to take cute pictures for them for the mod images but they just kept falling asleep. Rest assured, they are very cute.

The pet images come from the game files, but they aren't used.

You can adjust the price in the config to 30k, 50k, 80k, 1mil, 2mil, or 4mil. They cost 1mil by default.

You purchase them by adopting a pet from Marnie after reaching full friendship with your first pet.

There's an Alternative Textures version [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24892]here[/url] if you prefer that.
